Definition: Akkub, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Akkub is the name of several Israelites. One is a gatekeeper of the temple in the days of the return, one is listed among the Nethinim who came back with Zerubbabel, one is a Levite who helps the people understand the law when Ezra reads it, and one is a descendant of David in the royal line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gatekeepers and the Levites who explain the law are as much a part of the story as the kings, because the temple only stands when ordinary faithful people hold its doors.
